# fastclick-rcv

Measure the receiving rate of a DPDK port using FastClick.

Receives packets on a single DPDK port and reports the average link rate
(`RESULT-RX`) and hardware-dropped packets (`RESULT-DROPPED`) using an
AverageCounter element.

Usage:
```bash
%import@dut fastclick-rcv NT=4
```

Source: [`modules/fastclick-rcv.npf`](https://github.com/tbarbette/npf/blob/main/modules/fastclick-rcv.npf)

## Variables

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `NT` | `1` | Number of receive threads |
| `NDESC` | `256` | Number of RX descriptors |
| `NB_MBUF` | `65536` | Number of memory buffers |

```{collapse} Late variables

Late variables are evaluated after the variables above.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `AVGCNT` | `IF($NT > 1,AverageCounterMP,AverageCounter)` |  |
```
